description: Architecture or policy rationale capturing constraints, trade-offs, and preferred future direction. Topic: rein-architectural-limits-and-scale-ceilings-as-of-v0-21-0.

evidence.content:
Honest assessment of rein's structural constraints for informing v0.22+ design decisions. Not bugs — explicit trade-offs from single-user, single-binary, zero-ops posture.

## Storage (SQLite + sqlite-vec)

- Single-writer: WAL + per-request connection mitigates but doesn't eliminate. proxy/hooks/user/GC all write.
- Embedding-inside-memories: 3072d f32 = 12KB/row. DB is 60-70% vectors. Switching embedding model requires full `rebuild_vector_index`.
- Migration cost: ALTER TABLE RENAME on `memories` is copy-all-rows + DROP + DDL dance. At 1M rows, locks DB for minutes. v0.21 also hit the deep bug where SQLite rewrites FK references in dependent tables to point at `memories_old`; fixed via `PRAGMA legacy_alter_table = 1`.
- HNSW resident in process memory (usearch). Large indexes = several GB RAM.

## Runtime

- Search 3 channels (FTS/vec/KG) run **serially** in `recall.rs`. ~10-30ms latency left on the table.
- rusqlite is blocking I/O. tokio integration needs `spawn_blocking`. async doesn't fully cash out for DB-bound ops.
- LLM calls single-path (extract/rerank/expand), Gemini or OMLX — no N-provider failover, only rule-based fallback.
- Proxy is record-only: can't intelligently route on upstream failure.

## Algorithms

- Dedup quality for cross-lingual / near-duplicate ("fixed X" vs "X was fixed") depends on LLM; effect not uniformly good.
- M3 survival curves cold-start: < 50 observations per cluster → fallback to fixed Ebbinghaus.
- M5 tier boundary via t-digest has ~5% boundary jitter.
- KG concept extraction stays coarse; user-invoked refine is still frequent.
- Adaptive α cold start: first ~100 recalls use fixed strategy alphas.

## Product / deployment

- Single-user, single-binary. Cross-device sync only via optional Supermemory cloud.
- GUI embedded via rust-embed (`--features gui`). Cannot deploy GUI independently.
- B1 MCP aggregator not done — multiple rein instances can't compose. v0.22.
- No multi-tenancy. Cloud deployment = one instance per user.
- Background GC + HNSW rebuild run in main process; no external worker.

## Where rein hits a wall

| Scale | Behavior |
|---|---|
| <100K memories | All smooth, DB ~100s of MB |
| 100K-1M | Embedding column dominates, migration takes minutes, M4 recluster takes seconds |
| 1M-10M | `memories` table 10GB+, full-table sweeps painful, need to externalize embeddings |
| 10M+ | SQLite stops making sense; switch to Postgres + pgvector or dedicated vector store |

## Three structural ceilings (not bugs, architecture)

1. SQLite single-writer + embedding-inside-row ⇒ ~1M memories practical max
2. Synchronous search + blocking I/O ⇒ single-request latency floor ~50-100ms
3. Single-tenant / single-machine ⇒ team / cloud scenarios need re-architecture

None are blocking for "personal memory system" use case. All three need rework before serving teams or going multi-tenant.

## Immediate pain vs. future pain

Immediate (every day): search channel serialization, dedup edge cases, occasional SQLITE_BUSY on burst write.
Future: scale ceiling at 1M, B1 federation absence, embedding model swap cost.

description: Architecture or policy rationale capturing constraints, trade-offs, and preferred future direction. Topic: rein-philosophical-direction.

evidence.content:
rein 长线哲学方向（2026-04-15 总结自历次反馈和决策）

## 四条隐含长线

### 1. Canonical-first read model 深化
- 当前：默认返回 canonical + evidence on demand（v0.16+）
- 未来：全面去除「raw memory」概念，所有读路径统一走 canonical/evidence 两层
- 动作点：recall、recent、MCP tools、GUI 的 Memory 列表最终都只暴露 canonical；evidence 仅在 drill-down 时返回
- 影响：API schema 简化、去掉 superseded_by 在读路径的分叉逻辑

### 2. Provenance-preserving everything
- 已做：dedup 合并时不丢时间锚和 unique details（provenance-preserving merge）
- 未来扩展：evolution/refine/consolidate 全链路 provenance 追踪
- 方向：可解释性 —— 任一 canonical 都能回溯到原始 raw 片段、合并时刻、refine 历史、supporting episodes
- 动作点：concept_revisions 已有革命历史；可扩展到 memory-level 的 provenance chain，GUI 展示 lineage graph

### 3. Local-first / privacy-preserving
- 当前：SQLite + Tantivy + HNSW + OMLX 本地 LLM 全栈可选
- 未来：继续往 fully offline 走，降低对云 API 依赖
- 动作点：默认 config 优先 OMLX，Gemini 作为 fallback；embedding 本地化（已有 cache，需探索本地 embedding model）；proxy 可选完全 disable
- 隐含：这也意味着性能优化重心在 local compute 而非 API latency

### 4. Code / devlog 严格分离
- 用户执行得很严的工程哲学（feedback 记忆中多次确认）
- 源码永远不含 devlog/roadmap/strategy 内容，分离到 docs/
- 未来可能演化成：architectural docs 自动生成 / drift 检测工具
- 动作点：AGENTS.md 是源头，CLAUDE.md 是提示；未来可由工具扫描 src/ 自动验证与 docs/guides/architecture.md 的一致性，CI 里跑 drift check

## 共同底色
- 零主观参数、数据驱动自适应（feedback memory 已有）
- 不引入非必要抽象（feedback memory 已有）
- 不部署早：cargo install 只在全部工作收尾后（feedback memory 已有）

这 4 条不是独立 feature 而是持续演化的「形而上约束」——任何新 PR / 设计决策都应对齐这些方向。

## 近期可落地信号
- Canonical-first：MCP recall 默认已改；下一步可能是 `rein_recent` 也改 canonical-only
- Provenance：可以从 memory evolution 加 provenance_chain JSON 字段开始
- Local-first：目前缺本地 embedding 模型支持，是主要短板
- Drift check：可以写个简单脚本对比 AGENTS.md 声明的模块职责 vs 实际 src/*.rs 顶部文档字符串

description: Architecture or policy rationale capturing constraints, trade-offs, and preferred future direction. Topic: lowconfidencemode.

evidence.content:
违反「zero subjective params」核心哲学

[[feedback_no_subjective_params.md]] 写得很明确：所有参数都要 data-driven / self-adaptive。而 Phase 1 引入的 knobs：

- `confidence: f32`（谁给这个阈值？LLM 自报的数值可校准吗？）
- `low_confidence_fact_mode: LowConfidenceMode`
- `compression_aggressiveness: CompressionLevel`
- 「Low-confidence facts: keep them, mark them lower-priority」——「lower-priority」是多少？
- 「exact duplicate fold / temporal version preservation / conflict bucket」的阈值（什么算 time_hint 相同？subject 的 string match 还是 canonicalization？）

每个 knob 要么靠数据挣到 ship 资格，要么不 ship。现在全是 hand-picked。

---

## 与 approved v0.23 plan 的 scope 冲突

| v0.23 plan 明确约定 | 本 design doc 做的事 |
|---|---|
| 单柱子 = Resummerize | 双柱子 = Fact Layer + Resummerize |
| 「不把整个 compression-intelligence program 一次打包进来」 | Block 1-6 就是把它整体打包 |
| Week-3 bail-out 退回 eval harness | 没讨论 bail-out 时 fact layer 怎么处置 |
| 护栏是 invariant tests / regression | 护栏是结构化 fact + 结构化 output contract |
| Compression-intelligence 延到 v0.24 | 现在就把底盘铺了 |

Bail-out 场景下的风险非常具体：第 3 周 eval 失败 → ship 退回 eval harness → 已经 land 的 4 个表 + 7 个模块 + 独立 queue/worker 变成 **schema/migration 负债但没有强消费者**。未来要拆或保留都成本高。

---

## 反向方案（对齐 v0.23 plan）

**v0.23 实际交付：**

description: Architecture or policy rationale capturing constraints, trade-offs, and preferred future direction. Topic: rein-proxy-architecture.

evidence.content: Recorded the architectural distinction between Claude proxy and Codex subscription proxy. Claude Code proxy is comparatively simple because it is effectively public Anthropic API proxying (Claude Code -> rein -> Anthropic /v1/messages) where base URL override and auth header passthrough are natural. Codex API-key proxy is similarly manageable via custom model_provider + wire_api=responses + supports_websockets=false + OPENAI_API_KEY, routing to api.openai.com/v1/responses. Codex subscription/OAuth proxy is different: Codex source shows ChatGPT auth mode defaults to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex while API-key mode defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Therefore subscription proxy is a first-party backend gateway involving ChatGPT access_token, chatgpt_account_id, plan/workspace info, discovery/models/bootstrap, WebSocket, sticky routing, reconnect/fallback, first-party headers, and host/origin assumptions. Correct next step is support matrix and transparent first-party forwarding before record-only extraction. Added Obsidian note docs/devlog/2026-04-16-claude-vs-codex-proxy-complexity.md and linked it from docs/00-INDEX.md.

description: Architecture or policy rationale capturing constraints, trade-offs, and preferred future direction. Topic: codex-subscription-proxy.

evidence.content: Phase A plus an initial Phase B compatibility slice landed for the Codex subscription proxy. Based on official openai/codex HEAD b0324f9, rein now distinguishes two first-party upstream families: `chatgpt_upstream` (`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api`) for helper/discovery paths like `/wham/*`, `/connectors/*`, `/v1/agent/register`, `/authenticate_app_v2`, and `/codex/safety/arc`; and `codex_upstream` (`https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`) for model API paths like `/responses`, `/responses/compact`, `/models`, and `/memories/trace_summarize`. Proxy route resolution now uses both path shape and JWT semantics to distinguish ChatGPT-login traffic from public OpenAI Responses traffic, and first-party routes explicitly disable structured recording for now to preserve transparent-forwarding semantics. Added proxy tests cover ambiguous `/responses` and `/models` under ChatGPT login, helper/discovery paths, prefixed `/backend-api/*` rewrites, and route-family separation. Also added an Obsidian support-matrix document at `docs/reference/codex-subscription-proxy-support-matrix.md`.
